day_focus: Balance the drive for ministry outreach with a steady, present heart for Maria and the kids.
checkin: It's Throwback Thursday, son; take a moment to look back at how far the Lord has brought us without letting yesterday's wins or losses crowd out today. Outreach is a blessing, but remember that your first and most important ministry is right here under your own roof. Keep your pace steady and your heart open—the work will be there, but these moments with the family won't.
